title: What are the fastest UCI-legal road wheels? Wind tunnel testing the big-name brands and Chinese contenders
notes: Member-exclusive wind-tunnel feature by Josh Croxton, published 30 July 2026. Farsports EVO C6 (model year not stated): measured 1,351 g (610 g front, 741 g rear), 58 mm depth, hooked, 24.17/24.04 mm inner and 30.3/30.5 mm outer width; 66.89 W at 40 km/h on 28 mm tires, 3.72 W saved against the shallow reference wheelset. The author calls the aero result disappointing but notes the price is about a quarter of the most expensive set tested.
